newsitem.title: UK: Sun Life off on bid talk, DKB downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Sun Life off on bid talk, DKB downgrade.

text.p: Shares in insurance group Sun Life & Provincial Holdings Plc slipped on Monday after analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson cut the stock to "hold" from "buy" following weekend press reports the company may be on the takeover trail, dealers said.
The shares were 5-1/2p lower to 348p by 0830 GMT.
The Mail on Sunday said the insurer was under pressure to launch a bid for Birmingham Midshires building society, to rival a likely offer of 800 million stg from the Royal Bank of Scotland.
Sun Life currently has an exclusive agreement to sell insurance policies through the society.
Market sources said analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson cut their recommendation on the stock in response to the speculation.
"I would think most people will hold rather than buy this stock until we find out what is happening on the Birmingham Midshires situation," one senior dealer said.
